params.body:
Ilse (dealer team, 2026-09-16): on Settings > Website the "Merken" field was a dropdown with a search box and a checkbox per brand; picking was awkward and clearing it worse. She wanted to type.

## What changed for the dealer

- The chosen brands are chips with an x each. A text field filters the brand list while typing, accent-insensitive ("citroen" finds Citroën). Enter or a click adds, Backspace in an empty field removes the last chip, "Wis alles" empties the field.
- Keyboard: arrow keys move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape closes; combobox and listbox roles with `aria-activedescendant`, an `aria-label` per remove button.
- On the phone every target is 44 px (chips, their x, the options, "Wis alles"); on desktop the compact sizes.
- The field posts exactly what it posted before: one hidden `website_manufacturers_ids[]` per chip, the bare `website_manufacturers_ids` in front of it. Controller and `UpdateWebsiteRequest` are untouched. The initial chips and hidden inputs are rendered server-side too, so a post before Alpine starts still carries the saved choice.

## How

- New reusable component `resources/views/components/ui/chips-select.blade.php` (props `name`, `options` `[id => label]`, `selected`, `placeholder`, `label`). Alpine logic registered by the component itself on `alpine:init` (`@once`), no change to `layouts/app.blade.php`. Styling is Tailwind inside the component, `ui-input` for the field ground; no new rules in `refresh.css`.
- Used for the brands field only in this PR.
- Labels in `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/global.php` (`type_to_add`, `clear_all`, `remove_item`, `no_matches`, `all_chosen`).
- Rule R S2-5.21 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md`.

## Candidates for the same component (not in this PR)

- Settings > Website: country (`website_country_id[]`) and fuel type (`website_fuel_types_ids[]`), same tab.
- Settings > Dealer form: favourite dealers (`dealer_ids[]`), brands (`manufacturers_ids[]`), fuel types (`fuel_types_ids[]`).
- Settings > Vehicle options and option values: VWE codes (`vwe_code[]`).

## Tests

`ChipsSelectTest` (new, 4 tests): the component renders the chosen chips and hidden inputs in order and drops unknown ids and the empty pair; an empty selection renders no hidden input and the placeholder; the website tab renders the chips select with the saved choice and keeps the bare field; a PUT to `settings.update.website` with the same names saves `a,b` and an empty post deletes the setting (meaning all brands). Also green: `AlpineExpressionTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest`, `WebsiteEmbedSettingsTest`, `SmokeTest` (261 tests).

Screenshots at 1440 and 390 with three brands chosen and the list open were checked locally.
params.title: Website settings: brands are picked by typing, shown as chips
